summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PromptSentry. 13/13 pytest backend tests passed (validation, generate-probes for NovaBank/recipe/dynamic policy, run-probes schema errors, full run flow, evidence integrity verbatim substring check, repeatability). Frontend Playwright end-to-end confirmed: NovaBank demo load, stress test button disabled during run, phase indicator, both probe cards (probe-card-01/02) render with attacks, target responses, verdicts, evidence handling, result-summary '2 / 2 attacks resisted', validation errors for empty/short/too-long prompts (no backend call for validation). Confirmed no EMERGENT_LLM_KEY or sk-emergent secret exposed in page source or network. Only /api/generate-probes and /api/run-probes hit backend. Dynamic probe generation verified (new rule injection returns tailored probes).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['EMERGENT_LLM_KEY'] which will crash at import if unset; consider a clearer startup error message.
generate/run-probes lack an overall server-side request timeout wrapper; a stuck upstream call could hang. Model calls rely purely on emergentintegrations defaults.

Evidence substring check is case- and whitespace-sensitive (exact substring). This is intentional per spec and correct, but could yield more INCONCLUSIVE than needed for near-verbatim quotes. Acceptable trade-off.
No rate limiting; endpoints hit paid LLM API with unauthenticated public POST. Fine for demo, worth flagging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all critical flows. Session-scoped fixtures reuse generated probes to save LLM calls. Live model calls take ~5-25s each; pytest run ~26s total. Frontend testids all present and working.
